spec_source: docs/RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md section 4, reduced to the E1 synthetic LoRA causal LM so that the full factorial fits one CPU session
model: SyntheticLoRACausalLM (scripts/run_paper_experiments_and_figures.py), d_model=64, rank 8, vocab 64; disjoint 128-sequence held-out split
arrival_model: per learner per round: t = lognormal(median 1.0, sigma 0.25) compute units; with probability 0.2 the learner is a straggler and t is multiplied by uniform(3, 8). Sampled once per (M, seed) and replayed identically across all cells. This is a parametric model, not a WAN trace; artifacts/wan_quic_turn_fault_report.json only contains localhost latencies and is not used.

admission_rules.all: wait for every learner (K = M); wall per round = max arrival + sync
admission_rules.quorum_grace: K = ceil(M/2); AdaptiveGraceWindowController(tau=2, gamma=0.5, ema_beta=0.5, sync=0.1) fed with the median arrival as step duration and the K-th arrival as quorum duration; learners inside the window admitted; deferred learners contribute their delta at the next round with staleness tau=1 and skip that round's fresh compute
admission_rules.quorum_random: same K; window length drawn uniform in [0, 2 * mean adaptive window of the same (M, seed)] so the expected window matches the adaptive cell (matched-random control)

gate_rule: the outer optimizer is Nesterov in every cell; 'cgad' multiplies each stale learner delta by sigma(tau) = 0.5(1+cos(pi tau/32)) exp(-0.2 tau) before merging (PA-CGAD gate factor only, so that the gate is the sole difference)
metrics: mean pairwise cosine between learner deltas per round
loss at matched wall budget (for RQ3)

acceptance_rules.P2: best outer_lr = argmin over the grid of the 3-seed mean final loss. Supported if under 'direct' the best lr at M=8 is strictly larger than at M=4 and under 'rda' it is the same grid point; refuted if the rda best lr moves by >= 1 grid step; inapplicable (reported as such) if the mean pairwise cosine of learner deltas exceeds 0.3 in magnitude
acceptance_rules.P3: at the best lr of each cell and the same (M, seed), compare the held-out loss reached within the smaller of the two cells' total wall budgets; supported if adaptive < random with the 95% t-interval of the paired seed differences excluding 0; refuted if random <= adaptive; inconclusive otherwise
acceptance_rules.P4: gate gain = mean final loss(ungated) - mean final loss(cgad) at the best lr; reported under quorum_grace (stale deltas present) and under all (no stale deltas, gain must be 0 by construction = negative control); supported if gain under quorum_grace > 0 with CI excluding 0 and the gate never raises loss by more than the CI

controls.positive: stale_burst cell: admission 'all', ungated, but every learner delta at rounds 4 and 8 is replaced by the delta computed from the global state of round 0 (staleness 40 rounds, as in E2); its final loss must exceed the clean 'all' cell at the same lr, otherwise the harness cannot see staleness and the run is invalid
controls.negative_1: rda_identity: with all M learners holding the same shard and the same seed, rda merge must equal direct merge to within 1e-5 relative
controls.negative_2: grace_gamma0: AdaptiveGraceWindowController with gamma = 0 must admit exactly the first K learners every round

seeds_and_statistics: 3 seeds per cell; mean and 95% t-interval (df=2); an effect is claimed only if the interval excludes 0
